items.note: 94.9 sec Hindi reel downloaded/transcribed; GitHub repo cross-checked. Reel demonstrates an independently made browser named Veil, Tor routing/relays, IP-location lookup, DuckDuckGo onion search and opening onion pages. Repo says it is an educational project, NOT security-audited; intended for macOS/Linux and depends on Tor. Do not use it where anonymity/safety matters—use official Tor Browser instead. Reel claim “Tor Browser is not anonymous” is too absolute: Tor Project says perfect anonymity is impossible, but Tor Browser has privacy protections and usage caveats. Creator’s claim that his laptop was compromised is unverified anecdote. Hidden Wiki/dark-web listings may expose users to scams, malware or illegal material; do not follow those links. Repo says MIT license; review code and platform requirements before use.

items.title: Monday AI News: ChatGPT Business Hub, GPT-6.2, MAI Code 2 aur Gemini 4 Neon — phir 3 models ka website test (Beyond Tahir)
items.section: YouTube: AI news and model comparisons
items.note: 13:11 Urdu/Hindi news roundup with chaptered demos: ChatGPT business claims/discovery, merchant product feeds, Sales plugin, GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol, Microsoft MAI Code 2, Gemini 4 Neon, then the same open-ended website prompt in three models and creator’s visual/model preference. Treat the final comparison as one creator’s demo, not a controlled benchmark. Fact-check caveats: OpenAI says Business Hub claims require verification and eligibility; claiming does not guarantee higher placement, and Business Agents are currently limited to eligible businesses in the US (expansion planned). Merchant page says ChatGPT shopping is currently live in the US; applicants may be waitlisted—so the reel’s “free signup and immediate product visibility in Pakistan” is not established. Official OpenAI model page confirms GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol but its listed Astra API prices are $8/$40 per million input/output tokens and Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol pricing, which does not match the reel’s spoken price figures. MAI Code 2 and Gemini 4 Neon have official product pages; check current plan/region access. Reel title calls model “Claude 5.2”; description/model identity in this one-prompt demo was not independently verified. Automated access to the Microsoft MAI Code 2 page returned HTTP 403 during the final link audit, so that direct link is omitted until it can be verified in a normal browser; this response alone does not prove the page is dead.

items.title: The AI System — Serge Gatari (Webby recording; AI business systems aur client acquisition)
items.note: Folder check kiya: ek 1.93 GB MP4 “Serge Gatari - The AI System Webby Recording.mp4”, ek “0 Join Us” folder aur 3 PDFs hain. PDF “🎁 for telegram users” Meer Store ka ad hai; “00- 💸 Earning Websites” Meer Tech Zone/Meer Store ke WhatsApp/Telegram channels aur courses ka promotional flyer hai—course lessons nahi. Paid Webby recording ki unauthorized re-upload ho sakti hai—sirf apne study ke liye, redistribute/re-upload na karein. Full 1.93 GB video download karke inspect nahi ki (size bara); search mein third-party sellers “4+ hours” batate hain, duration ko independently verify nahi kiya. # Aik 3D Studio — GitHub par dalne ki guide (Roman Urdu)

Is folder main do cheezein hain. Jo asaan lage woh istemal karo.

| Cheez | Kya hai | Kab kaam aati hai |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Aik-3D-Studio.html` | Poora tool **aik hi file** main | Double-click karo, Chrome main khul jata hai. Internet ki zaroorat nahi. |
| Poora folder (repository) | Code, README, licence, `docs/` | GitHub par dalne ke liye, taake log dekhein aur istemal karein. |

---

## Tareeqa 1: sab se asaan (sirf aik file) — mobile se bhi ho jata hai

1. [github.com](https://github.com) par login karo. Account nahi hai to **Sign up** se free bana lo.
2. Upar **+** dabao → **New repository**.
3. **Repository name** main likho: `aik-3d-studio`. **Public** chuno. **Create repository** dabao.
4. Naye page par **uploading an existing file** wale link par click karo.
5. `Aik-3D-Studio.html` file chuno (ya kheench kar chhoro). Neeche **Commit changes** dabao.
6. Repository main **Settings** → left side par **Pages** kholo.
7. **Branch** main `main` chuno, folder `/ (root)` rehne do, **Save** dabao.
8. 1–2 minute ruko. Tumhara tool is link par chalega:

   ```
   https://TUMHARA-USERNAME.github.io/aik-3d-studio/Aik-3D-Studio.html
   ```

   `TUMHARA-USERNAME` ki jagah apna GitHub naam likho. Yeh link kisi ko bhi bhej sakte ho.

---

## Tareeqa 2: poori repository (code ke sath) — PC se karo

1. `Aik-3D-Studio-repo.zip` download karo aur PC par **Extract** karo.
2. GitHub par nayi repository banao (upar wale step 1–3).
3. **uploading an existing file** par click karo.
4. Extract kiye hue `aik-3d-studio` folder ko **kholo**, andar ki **sari cheezein** select karo
   (`docs`, `src`, `public`, `tools`, `licenses`, `examples`, `README.md`, `GUIDE.md`, `LICENSE`, `package.json`,
   `package-lock.json`, `Aik-3D-Studio.html`) aur browser main kheench kar chhor do.
   Dhyan: folder ke **andar** ki cheezein dalni hain, khud folder nahi. `docs` seedha repository main nazar aana chahiye.
5. **Commit changes** dabao.
6. **Settings → Pages** → Branch `main`, folder **`/docs`** chuno → **Save**.
7. 1–2 minute baad tool yahan chalega:

   ```
   https://TUMHARA-USERNAME.github.io/aik-3d-studio/
   ```

`.gitignore` file Windows main chhupi hoti hai. Woh upload na ho to koi masla nahi.

## Tool kaise chalana hai

1. **Templates** dabao aur koi design chuno.
2. Tasveer main cheez par click karo. **Object** tab main alfaaz aur motai badlo, **Style** tab main rang.
3. **Animate** tab main chuno ke cheez kaise aaye, hile aur jaye. ▶ dabao aur dekho.
4. Apni marzi ki harkat: **◆ Add keyframe** dabao, time line aage karo, phir cheez ko hilao.
5. **Export** dabao: PNG tasveer, MP4 video ya GIF. PC slow ho to **Half size** chuno.

Video ke liye **Chrome** ya **Edge** istemal karo.

## Agar masla aaye

- **Link par 404 aata hai:** 2–3 minute aur ruko, phir page refresh karo. Settings → Pages main dekho ke Branch `main` chuni hui hai.
- **Tareeqa 2 main khali page:** `docs` folder repository ke andar seedha nazar aana chahiye, kisi aur folder ke andar nahi.
- **Export ki file download nahi hoti:** tool ko chat ke preview ki jagah Chrome main kholo (file par double-click, ya GitHub wala link).

# Aik 3D Studio

A free 3D text, logo and intro animation maker that runs in the browser.
Nothing to install, no account, and nothing is uploaded: everything is made on your own device.

It is made for the same jobs people use desktop "3D title maker" programs for:
YouTube intros and titles, 3D logo animations, and 3D text pictures for thumbnails and banners.

> Status: **Part 1 (version 0.1)**. The editor, animation and export work. The lists further down say
> exactly what is in, and what is not built yet.

## Use it

**Online (after you put it on GitHub Pages, see below):** open the page, press **Templates**, pick a design,
change the words, press **Export**.

**On your own computer:**

```bash
npm install
npm start          # builds, then serves http://localhost:5173
```

**Without anything at all:** download the single file `Aik-3D-Studio.html` and double-click it.
It is the whole tool in one file and works with no server and no internet.

A ready-built copy is also in `docs/`, so any static web host can serve that folder as it is.

### Put it on GitHub for free

1. Make a new repository on GitHub and upload this whole folder (keep the `docs/` folder).
2. In the repository open **Settings → Pages**.
3. Under **Build and deployment** choose **Deploy from a branch**, branch `main`, folder `/docs`, then **Save**.
4. After a minute the tool is live at `https://YOUR-NAME.github.io/YOUR-REPO/`.

## What it can do

| Area | In this version |
| --- | --- |
| 3D text | Extrude depth, rounded edges (bevel), letter and line gap, align, several lines |
| Fonts | 6 built in, plus **any TTF/OTF font file** from your computer |
| Shapes | 22 ready 2D shapes made 3D, 7 solid 3D bodies |
| Your own shapes | **Draw a shape** with points, straight or smooth, and edit the points later |
| Logos | **SVG import**, made 3D, with its own colours or one style |
| Pictures | PNG/JPG import as a flat card you can place and animate in 3D; picture background |
| Styles | 28 one-click styles (gold, chrome, glass, neon, two-colour…), plus colour, metal, roughness, see-through, own light |
| One-click animation | 15 entrance and exit effects, 10 looping motions, whole object or letter by letter (typewriter, wave, jump…) |
| Keyframes | Position, rotation, scale and opacity on a time line; 10 speed curves (linear, quad, cubic, quart, quint, back, bounce, elastic…) |
| Camera | Free camera with its own keyframes |
| Particles | Snow, rain, stars, fireworks, sparks, fire, smoke, bubbles, confetti, magic |
| Scene | Any picture size (YouTube, Shorts, square, banner, custom), length, frame rate, light direction and colour, shadow floor, glow |
| Templates | 10 starter designs |
| Editing | Move / rotate / size handles in the picture, undo and redo, duplicate, hide, save and open project files, auto-save in the browser |
| Export | PNG (also transparent), JPG, **MP4 video**, animated **GIF**, PNG frames in a ZIP |
| Devices | Desktop and phone layout |

## Not built yet

Planned for the next parts:

- Different colours or fonts for single letters inside one text
- Text in scripts that join letters or run right to left (Urdu, Arabic): letters come out separate and in the wrong order
- Animated light and animated background
- Turning a photo itself into a raised 3D object (a photo is a flat card for now)
- SVG outlines (strokes): only filled areas are made 3D
- A bigger library: more templates, shapes and styles
- Sound in the video
- Textures (wood, stone…) on objects

Will not be added, because a browser cannot do them or the format is dead:

- Flash SWF, FLV, AVI and MPG video. MP4 plays everywhere those did.
- TGA, TIFF and BMP pictures. PNG keeps full quality and transparency; free converters turn PNG into the others.

## How export works

Frames are drawn one by one from the time line and encoded in the browser, so the video is smooth even on a
slow computer; it just takes longer. Video uses the browser's own encoder (WebCodecs): MP4/H.264 when the
browser has it, WebM otherwise, and a real-time recording as a last fallback. Chrome and Edge are the safest
choice for video. On a computer with little memory choose **Half size** in the Export window.

## Project layout

```
public/          page and styles (copied to docs/ as they are)
src/model.js     the project file format, defaults, undo
src/assets.js    fonts, shapes, styles, speed curves, effects, particle presets
src/engine.js    three.js scene: builds objects and poses them for any time t
src/exporter.js  PNG / MP4 / WebM / GIF
src/templates.js starter designs
src/app.js       the editor: panels, time line, dialogs
tools/           build script and a small local server
docs/            the built site (this is what GitHub Pages serves)
Aik-3D-Studio.html  the whole tool as one file (made by the build)
GUIDE.md         step-by-step guide in Roman Urdu
examples/        a sample SVG logo to try the import
```

`npm run build` rebuilds `docs/` and `Aik-3D-Studio.html` after you change anything in `src/` or `public/`.

A project is saved as one `.aik3d.json` file: plain JSON holding the scene, the objects and their keyframes.

## Licence and credits

Aik 3D Studio is MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`). It is its own program with its own name, design, templates
and code; it contains nothing from any other 3D title product.

It is built on [three.js](https://threejs.org) (MIT), [gifenc](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc) (MIT),
[mp4-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer) and [webm-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/webm-muxer) (MIT).
The built-in fonts come with three.js: Helvetiker and Optimer (MgOpen licence) and Droid Sans / Droid Serif
(Apache 2.0). Their licence texts are in `licenses/`.

<script>
const LIB = /*__DATA__*/;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
const size = b => !b ? '' : b >= 1e9 ? (b/1e9).toFixed(1)+'GB' : b >= 1e6 ? Math.round(b/1e6)+'MB' : Math.max(1,Math.round(b/1e3))+'KB';
const KIND = {Video:'▶ VIDEO',PDF:'PDF',Image:'IMAGE',Template:'TEMPLATE',Text:'TEXT','Web page':'PAGE',Doc:'DOC',Preset:'PRESET',File:'FILE'};
const KIND_S = {Video:'VID',PDF:'PDF',Image:'IMG',Template:'TPL',Text:'TXT','Web page':'WEB',Doc:'DOC',Preset:'SET',File:'FILE'};
const GROUPS = [['Video','▶ VIDEO'],['PDF','PDF'],['Image','IMAGE'],['Other','OTHER']];
const group = k => (k === 'Video' || k === 'PDF' || k === 'Image') ? k : 'Other';
const ICON = {
  proj:'<path d="M3 7.5 12 3l9 4.5v9L12 21l-9-4.5z"/><path d="M3 7.5 12 12l9-4.5M12 12v9"/>',
  lab:'<path d="M9 3h6M10 3v6l-5 9a2 2 0 0 0 1.8 3h10.4a2 2 0 0 0 1.8-3l-5-9V3"/><path d="M7.5 15h9"/>',
  courses:'<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M10 8l5 2.5-5 2.5zM8 21h8"/>',
  agents:'<rect x="5" y="8" width="14" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M12 4.5V8M9.5 16h5M2.5 12.5v3M21.5 12.5v3"/><path stroke-width="2.6" d="M9 12.5h.01M15 12.5h.01M12 3.5h.01"/>',
  prompts:'<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 9l3 3-3 3M13 15h4"/>',
  economy:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.5 3 14.5 0 18M12 3c-3 3.5-3 14.5 0 18"/>',
  invest:'<path d="M3 17l6-6 4 4 8-8M15 7h6v6"/>',
  content:'<path d="M3 10v4h3l7 4V6l-7 4H3zM16.5 9a4 4 0 010 6M19 6.5a8 8 0 010 11"/>',
  accounts:'<rect x="2.5" y="5" width="19" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M2.5 10h19M6 15h4"/>',
  book:'<path d="M5 4h11a3 3 0 013 3v13H8a3 3 0 01-3-3zM5 17a3 3 0 013-3h11"/>',
  code:'<path d="M8 8l-4 4 4 4M16 8l4 4-4 4M13.5 5l-3 14"/>',
  folder:'<path d="M3 7a2 2 0 012-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 012 2v8a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2z"/>',
  movies:'<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M7.5 5v14M16.5 5v14M3 9.5h4.5M3 14.5h4.5M16.5 9.5H21M16.5 14.5H21"/>',
  tools:'<path d="M14.7 6.3a4 4 0 00-5.3 5.3L3.5 17.5l3 3 5.9-5.9a4 4 0 005.3-5.3l-2.7 2.7-2.4-.6-.6-2.4z"/>',
  all:'<rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="13.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="13.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/>',
  check:'<path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/>'
};
const svg = n => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${ICON[n] || ICON.folder}</svg>`;
const catBy = Object.fromEntries(LIB.categories.map(c => [c.name, c]));
const shortOf = Object.fromEntries(LIB.categories.map(c => [c.name, c.short || c.name.toUpperCase()]));
const itemBy = Object.fromEntries(LIB.items.map(i => [i.id, i]));
const state = { cat: LIB.categories[0].name, q:'', kind:'All', view:'All', labKind:'All', labTested:false };
/* AGENTS LAB: LIB.agents = tamam agents; chat = yes | half | no (isi chat mein chala kar check ho sakta hai ya nahi) */
const LAB = '@lab';
const AGENTS = LIB.agents || [];
const isLab = () => state.cat === LAB;
const LAB_SECS = [['yes','Isi chat mein check ho sakte hain'],['half','Adha: aap ka account ya key chahiye'],['no','Is chat mein nahi chal sakte']];
const LAB_KIND = {agent:'AGENT', pack:'AGENTS PACK', skill:'SKILL', mcp:'MCP', flow:'MAKE AUTOMATION', tool:'TOOL', list:'LIST'};
const LAB_ORDER = ['agent','pack','skill','mcp','flow','tool','list'];
/* PROJECTS: LIB.projects = jo software aur kaam bane. group = chat (is chat mein) | old (pehle ke, Ai School Drive folder se) */
const PROJ = '@proj';
const PROJECTS = LIB.projects || [];
const isProj = () => state.cat === PROJ;
const PROJ_GROUPS = [['chat','Is chat mein bane'],['old','Pehle ke projects (Ai School Drive folder se)']];
const PROJ_NOTE = {old:'Yeh is chat mein nahi bane. Maloomat 13 Nov ki jaanch aur aaj parhi hui files se hai. Naam dabane se Drive ka link copy hota hai.'};
const P_STATUS = {live:'CHAL RAHA HAI', done:'MUKAMMAL', building:'BAN RAHA HAI', code:'CODE MAUJOOD', copy:'DOOSRE KA PROJECT', notbuilt:'NAHI BANA'};
const P_KIND = {app:'APP', tool:'TOOL', report:'REPORT', bot:'BOT', copy:'COPY'};
const projHay = p => [p.id, p.name, p.what, p.stage, P_STATUS[p.status], P_KIND[p.kind], (p.tech||[]).join(' '), (p.done||[]).join(' '), (p.todo||[]).join(' '),
  ['sources','data','outputs'].map(g => (p[g]||[]).map(f => (f.path||f.name)+' '+f.about).join(' ')).join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase();
const folded = new Set();           /* band kiye hue hisse */
let shownItems = [], shownKey = i => i.category;
/* NEW: sirf tab jab library mein ek se zyada tareekh ka maal ho; sab se nayi tareekh wale items */
const addedDates = [...new Set(LIB.items.map(i => i.added).filter(Boolean))].sort();
const newDate = addedDates.length > 1 ? addedDates[addedDates.length - 1] : null;
const isNew = i => !!newDate && i.added === newDate;
const kindOk = i => state.kind === 'All' || (state.kind === 'New' ? isNew(i) : group(i.kind) === state.kind);
const foldKey = k => (state.q ? 'q' : state.cat) + '|' + k;
/* cover / preview files ko learning path ka pehla qadam nahi banate; woh list mein phir bhi maujood hain */
const supportItem = i => /(?:preview image|cover image|page image \(untitled\)|screenshot \(untitled\))/i.test(i.title);
const unseenFirst = items => items.find(i => !done.has(i.id) && !supportItem(i)) || items.find(i => !done.has(i.id)) || null;
const inView = items => state.view === 'Todo' ? items.filter(i => !done.has(i.id)) : state.view === 'Done' ? items.filter(i => done.has(i.id)) : items;

/* ── "dekh liya" nishan. Browser mein yaad rehte hain; chat ke preview mein yaad nahi rehte, is liye PROGRESS SAVE button hai ── */
const KEY = 'techno-library-done-v1';
let store = null;
try { store = window.localStorage; store.getItem(KEY); } catch(e){ store = null; }
const baked = new Set((LIB.done || []).filter(id => itemBy[id]));
let saved = {done:[], undone:[]};
try { if (store){ const s = JSON.parse(store.getItem(KEY)); if (s && Array.isArray(s.done) && Array.isArray(s.undone)) saved = s; } } catch(e){}
const done = new Set([...baked, ...saved.done].filter(id => itemBy[id] && !saved.undone.includes(id)));
function persist(){
  if (!store) return;
  try { store.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({done:[...done].filter(x => !baked.has(x)), undone:[...baked].filter(x => !done.has(x))})); } catch(e){}
}
const changed = () => done.size !== baked.size || [...done].some(x => !baked.has(x));

/* title ke shuru ka number ("3. ..." ya "Lesson 3 - ...") alag kar ke badge mein dikhate hain */
function split(t){
  const m = /^Lesson\s+(\d+)\s*[-–—:]\s*(.+)$/i.exec(t) || /^(\d{1,2})\.\s*(.+)$/.exec(t);
  return m ? {n:m[1], t:m[2]} : {n:'', t};
}
const words = () => state.q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
/* search ke lafz title mein roshan karta hai */
function hl(t){
  const q = words();
  if (!q.length) return esc(t);
  const re = new RegExp('(' + q.map(w => w.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('|') + ')', 'ig');
  return String(t).split(re).map((part, k) => k % 2 ? '<mark>' + esc(part) + '</mark>' : esc(part)).join('');
}
function scope(){
  const q = words();
  return LIB.items.filter(i => q.length
    ? q.every(w => (i.id+' '+i.title+' '+shortOf[i.category]+' '+i.section).toLowerCase().includes(w))
    : state.cat === 'All' || i.category === state.cat);
}
const oneShelf = () => !state.q && state.cat !== 'All';

function renderTiles(){
  const inCat = c => LIB.items.filter(i => i.category === c);
  const on = c => !state.q && state.cat === c;
  const tile = (key, label, icon, items, k) => {
    const d = items.filter(i => done.has(i.id)).length;
    const full = items.length > 0 && d === items.length;
    return `<button type="button" class="tile${full ? ' full' : ''}" data-cat="${esc(key)}" aria-pressed="${on(key)}" title="${esc(label)} · ${items.length} items${full ? ' · poori dekh li' : d ? ' · '+d+' dekh liye' : ''}${k <= 9 ? ' · key '+k : ''}">` +
      `${svg(icon)}<span class="lb">${esc(key === 'All' ? 'ALL' : shortOf[key])}</span><span class="n">${full ? '✓' : items.length}</span>${items.some(isNew) ? '<span class="dotnew"></span>' : ''}` +
      `<span class="pb" style="width:${items.length ? Math.round(d/items.length*100) : 0}%"></span></button>`;
  };
  $('tiles').className = 'tiles' + (state.q ? ' dim' : '');
  const ran = AGENTS.filter(a => a.tested).length;
  const labTile = !AGENTS.length ? '' :
    `<button type="button" class="tile lab" data-cat="${LAB}" aria-pressed="${on(LAB)}" title="Agents Lab · ${AGENTS.length} agents · ${ran} chala kar dekhe · key 1">` +
    `${svg('lab')}<span class="lb"><i class="lg">AGENTS </i>LAB</span><span class="n">${AGENTS.length}</span></button>`;
  const projTile = !PROJECTS.length ? '' :
    `<button type="button" class="tile proj" data-cat="${PROJ}" aria-pressed="${on(PROJ)}" title="Projects · ${PROJECTS.length} · jo software aur kaam bane · key ${labTile ? 2 : 1}">` +
    `${svg('proj')}<span class="lb">PROJECTS</span><span class="n">${PROJECTS.length}</span></button>`;
  const off = (labTile ? 1 : 0) + (projTile ? 1 : 0);
  $('tiles').innerHTML = labTile + projTile + LIB.categories.map((c, k) => tile(c.name, c.name, c.icon || 'folder', inCat(c.name), k+1+off)).join('') +
    tile('All', 'Poori library', 'all', LIB.items, LIB.categories.length+1+off);
}

function renderInfo(sc){
  const shown = inView(sc);
  const total = sc.reduce((s, i) => s + i.files.reduce((a, f) => a + (f.size || 0), 0), 0);
  const d = sc.filter(i => done.has(i.id)).length;
  const stat = `${sc.length} ITEMS${total ? ' · ' + size(total) : ''}${d ? ' · ✓ ' + d : ''}`;
  let head;
  if (state.q) head = `<h2>“${esc(state.q)}”</h2><span class="about">poori library mein dhoonda</span>`;
  else if (state.cat === 'All') head = `<h2>Poori library</h2><span class="about">sab shelves, tarteeb se</span>`;
  else head = `<h2>${esc(state.cat)}</h2><span class="about">${esc(catBy[state.cat].about || '')}</span>`;
  const counts = {}; shown.forEach(i => { const g = group(i.kind); counts[g] = (counts[g] || 0) + 1; });
  const present = GROUPS.filter(g => counts[g[0]]);
  const fresh = shown.filter(isNew).length;
  const chip = (k, label) => `<button type="button" class="kchip" data-kind="${k}" aria-pressed="${state.kind === k}">${label}</button>`;
  const chips = present.length < 2 && !fresh ? '' :
    chip('All', 'SAB') + (fresh ? chip('New', 'NAYA ' + fresh) : '') +
    (present.length < 2 ? '' : present.map(g => chip(g[0], g[1] + ' ' + counts[g[0]])).join(''));
  /* SIRF BAQI ka button tab hi aata hai jab kuch dekh liya ho aur kuch baqi ho */
  const todo = d && d < sc.length
    ? `<button type="button" class="viewchip" data-view="${state.view === 'Todo' ? 'All' : 'Todo'}" aria-pressed="${state.view === 'Todo'}" title="Sirf woh dikhao jo abhi nahi dekha">SIRF BAQI ${sc.length - d}</button>` : '';
  $('info').innerHTML = head + `<span class="stat">${stat}</span>` +
    (chips || todo ? `<div class="filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter">${chips}${todo}</div>` : '');
}

function renderDeck(){
  if (isLab()){ renderLabDeck(); return; }
  if (isProj()){ renderProjDeck(); return; }
  const own = scope();
  if (state.q && !own.length){
    $('deck').className = 'deck complete';
    $('deck').innerHTML = `<span class="beacon" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="copy"><span class="eyebrow">SEARCH</span><span class="nextname">Is naam ya number ka koi result nahi. Search saaf kar ke phir dekhein.</span></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const pick = unseenFirst(own);
  /* poori library ka agla: shelves ki tarteeb se (COURSES pehle), shelf number se nahi */
  const overall = unseenFirst(LIB.categories.flatMap(c => LIB.items.filter(i => i.category === c.name)));
  const outside = !pick && overall && oneShelf();
  const item = pick || overall;
  const left = LIB.items.length - done.size;
  if (!item){
    $('deck').className = 'deck complete';
    $('deck').innerHTML = `<span class="beacon" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="copy"><span class="eyebrow">MISSION COMPLETE</span><span class="nextname">Zabardast — ${LIB.items.length} mein se sab dekh liya.</span></div><span class="meter">✓ ${LIB.items.length}/${LIB.items.length}</span>`;
    return;
  }
  const where = outside ? ` · agli shelf: ${shortOf[item.category]}` : !oneShelf() ? ` · ${shortOf[item.category]}` : '';
  $('deck').className = 'deck' + (outside ? ' complete' : '');
  $('deck').innerHTML = `<span class="beacon" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="copy"><span class="eyebrow">${outside ? 'IS SHELF KA KAAM HO GAYA' : 'UP NEXT'}</span><span class="nextname"><b>${item.id}</b> · ${esc(item.title)}${esc(where)}</span></div><span class="meter">${left} baqi</span><a class="continue" data-mark="${item.id}" href="${esc(item.files[0].url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-title="${item.id} · ${esc(item.title)}">KHOLEN ↗</a>`;
}

function row(i, n){
  const m = i.files[0], s = split(i.title), t = i.id + ' · ' + esc(i.title);
  return `<div class="row${done.has(i.id) ? ' done' : ''}${supportItem(i) ? ' support' : ''}" data-id="${i.id}" style="--i:${Math.min(n, 30)}">
    <a class="go" href="${esc(m.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-title="${t}" title="${esc(i.title)}">
      <span class="num${s.n ? '' : ' dot'}">${s.n || '•'}</span>
      <span class="body"><span class="title">${hl(s.t)}</span>

    ${i.files.slice(1).map(f => `<a class="extra" href="${esc(f.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-title="${t} (${esc(f.kind)})" title="${esc(f.kind)} bhi hai${f.size ? ' · ' + size(f.size) : ''}">+${KIND_S[f.kind] || 'FILE'}</a>`).join('')}
    <button type="button" class="tick" aria-pressed="${done.has(i.id)}" aria-label="Dekh liya: ${esc(i.title)}" title="Dekh liya (dobara dabane se hat jata hai)">${svg('check')}</button>
  </div>`;
}

function renderLabDeck(){
  const ran = AGENTS.filter(a => a.tested).length;
  $('deck').className = 'deck lab';
  $('deck').innerHTML = `<span class="beacon" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="copy"><span class="eyebrow">CHAT KA COMPUTER</span><span class="nextname">${esc((LIB.lab || {}).env || '')}</span></div><span class="meter">✓ ${ran}/${AGENTS.length} chala kar dekhe</span>`;
}
function labRow(a, n){
  const t = a.id + ' · ' + esc(a.name);
  const from = (a.from || []).map(f => `<span>${hl(f)}</span>`).join('');
  return `<div class="row arow s-${a.chat}" data-aid="${a.id}" style="--i:${Math.min(n, 30)}">

      <span class="body"><span class="title">${hl(a.name)}</span>

      (a.tested ? '<span class="bdg ok">✓ CHALA KAR DEKHA</span>' : a.chat === 'no' ? '' : '<span class="bdg todo">ABHI NAHI CHALAYA</span>') +
      (a.sure === false ? '<span class="bdg guess">REPO PAKKA NAHI</span>' : '') + from + `</span>
      <span class="what">${hl(a.what)}</span>` +
      (a.result ? `<span class="res">${esc(a.result)}</span>` : '') +
      (a.why ? `<span class="why">${esc(a.why)}</span>` : '') + `</span></a>
  </div>`;
}
function renderLab(animate){
  const q = words();
  const base = AGENTS.filter(a => !q.length || q.every(w => (a.id+' '+a.name+' '+a.what+' '+(LAB_KIND[a.kind]||'')+' '+(a.from||[]).join(' ')).toLowerCase().includes(w)));
  const kinds = LAB_ORDER.filter(k => base.some(a => a.kind === k));
  if (state.labKind !== 'All' && !kinds.includes(state.labKind)) state.labKind = 'All';
  const ranN = base.filter(a => a.tested).length;
  if (state.labTested && !ranN) state.labTested = false;
  const items = base.filter(a => (state.labKind === 'All' || a.kind === state.labKind) && (!state.labTested || a.tested));
  const chip = (k, label) => `<button type="button" class="kchip" data-labkind="${k}" aria-pressed="${state.labKind === k}">${label}</button>`;
  const head = q.length ? `<h2>“${esc(state.q)}”</h2><span class="about">Agents Lab mein dhoonda</span>` : `<h2>Agents Lab</h2><span class="about">tamam agents, aur kaun isi chat mein check ho sakta hai</span>`;
  $('info').innerHTML = head + `<span class="stat">${base.length} AGENTS · ✓ ${ranN} CHALAYE</span>` +
    `<div class="filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter">${chip('All', 'SAB')}${kinds.length > 1 ? kinds.map(k => chip(k, LAB_KIND[k] + ' ' + base.filter(a => a.kind === k).length)).join('') : ''}` +
    (ranN ? `<button type="button" class="viewchip" data-labtested="1" aria-pressed="${state.labTested}" title="Sirf woh dikhao jo chala kar dekhe gaye">SIRF CHALAYE HUE ${ranN}</button>` : '') + `</div>`;
  renderTiles(); renderLabDeck(); shownItems = [];

      `<span class="nm"><span class="st">${String(step).padStart(2, '0')}</span>${esc(label)}</span><span class="ln"></span><span class="ct">${ran ? '✓ ' + ran + '/' + its.length : its.length}</span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>`;

  }

  const note = q.length ? '' : `<p class="labnote">${esc((LIB.lab || {}).about || '')} Kisi ko chalwana ho to chat mein us ka number likhein, jaise <b>“${eg.id} chala kar dikhao”</b>.</p>` +
    `<div class="labkey"><span><span class="bdg ok">✓ CHALA KAR DEKHA</span> isi chat mein chal chuka</span><span><span class="bdg todo">ABHI NAHI CHALAYA</span> chal sakta hai, abhi try nahi hua</span><span><span class="bdg guess">REPO PAKKA NAHI</span> naam se dhoonda, andaza</span></div>`;

function renderProjDeck(){

Har aik ke sath: kya ban chuka, kya baqi hai, aur source files.</span></div>`;
}
function fileRow(p, grp, k, f){
  const meta = [f.lines ? f.lines + ' lines' : '', f.bytes ? size(f.bytes) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  const tag = f.missing ? 'FILE NAHI MILI' : f.code != null ? 'CODE DEKHEIN' : f.url ? 'LINK COPY' : 'PATH COPY';
  return `<button type="button" class="frow${f.missing ? ' miss' : ''}" data-file="${p.id}|${grp}|${k}" title="${f.code != null ? 'Dabane se code yahin khulta hai' : f.url ? 'Dabane se link copy hota hai' : 'Dabane se file ka path copy hota hai'}">` +
    `<span class="fp">${hl(f.path || f.name)}${meta ? `<small>${meta}</small>` : ''}</span><span class="fa">${hl(f.about || '')}</span><span class="fb${f.code != null ? ' code' : ''}">${tag}</span></button>`;
}
function projCard(p){
  const list = (cls, title, arr) => !arr || !arr.length ? '' :
    `<details class="pblock ${cls}" open><summary><b>${title}</b> ${arr.length}</summary><ul>${arr.map(x => `<li>${hl(x)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details>`;
  const files = (title, grp) => !(p[grp] || []).length ? '' :
    `<details class="pblock src pfiles" open><summary><b>${title}</b> ${p[grp].length}</summary>${p[grp].map((f, k) => fileRow(p, grp, k, f)).join('')}</details>`;
  const run = !(p.run || []).length ? '' :
    `<details class="pblock pfiles" open><summary><b>Chalane ka tareeqa</b></summary>${p.run.map(r => `<div class="pcmd"><button type="button" data-cmd="${esc(r.cmd)}" title="Dabane se copy hota hai">${esc(r.cmd)}</button><span>${esc(r.about || '')}</span></div>`).join('')}</details>`;
  return `<article class="pcard st-${p.status}" data-pid="${p.id}">
    <div class="phead"><span class="num">${p.id.slice(2)}</span><div class="body"><h3>${hl(p.name)}</h3>
      <div class="meta"><span class="id">${hl(p.id)}</span><span class="pst ${p.status}">${P_STATUS[p.status] || ''}</span><span class="bdg">${P_KIND[p.kind] || 'APP'}</span>` +
      (p.version ? `<span>${esc(p.version)}</span>` : '') + (p.licence ? `<span>${esc(p.licence)}</span>` : '') + `</div></div></div>
    <p class="pwhat">${hl(p.what)}</p>` + (p.stage ? `<p class="pstage">${hl(p.stage)}</p>` : '') +
    ((p.tech || []).length ? `<div class="ptech">${p.tech.map(x => `<span>${esc(x)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : '') +
    `<div class="pgrid">${list('ok', 'Ban chuka', p.done)}${list('todo', 'Baqi hai / dhyan', p.todo)}${list('', 'Kya check hua, kya nahi', p.tests)}</div>` +
    files('Source files', 'sources') + files('Data', 'data') + files('Tayyar files', 'outputs') + run +
    (p.next ? `<p class="pnext"><b>AGLA QADAM</b>${hl(p.next)}</p>` : '') + `</article>`;
}
function renderProj(animate){
  const q = words();
  const items = PROJECTS.filter(p => !q.length || q.every(w => projHay(p).includes(w)));
  const nCode = PROJECTS.reduce((s, p) => s + ['sources','data','outputs'].reduce((a, g) => a + (p[g] || []).filter(f => f.code != null).length, 0), 0);

  renderTiles(); renderProjDeck(); shownItems = [];
  $('pn').textContent = '✓ ' + done.size + '/' + LIB.items.length;
  $('pb').style.width = (done.size / LIB.items.length * 100) + '%';
  $('save').hidden = !!store || !changed();
  if (!items.length){
    $('list').innerHTML = `<div class="empty">Projects mein kuch nahi mila. Library mein dhoondne ke liye pehle koi shelf chunein.<button type="button" id="reset">Wapas</button></div>`;

  html += `<div class="pindex">${items.map(p => `<button type="button" class="pix" data-jump="${p.id}" title="Dabane se neeche is project par le jata hai"><span class="pid">${p.id}</span><span class="pnm">${hl(p.name)}</span><span class="pst ${p.status}">${P_STATUS[p.status] || ''}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`;

      (PROJ_NOTE[key] && !q.length ? `<p class="pnote">${esc(PROJ_NOTE[key])}</p>` : '') + ps.map(projCard).join('');

  $('list').innerHTML = `<div class="proj-list${animate ? ' anim' : ''}">${html}</div>`;

/* code dekhne wali khirki */
let viewerText = '';

async function copyLong(t){
  try { if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t); return true; } } catch(e){}
  try { const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = t; ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0'; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    const ok = document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove(); return ok; } catch(e){ return false; }

function renderList(animate){
  if (isLab()){ renderLab(animate); return; }
  if (isProj()){ renderProj(animate); return; }
  const sc = scope();
  const dn = sc.filter(i => done.has(i.id)).length;
  if (state.view !== 'All' && (!dn || dn === sc.length)) state.view = 'All';
  const viewed = inView(sc);
  if (state.kind !== 'All' && !viewed.some(kindOk)) state.kind = 'All';
  renderInfo(sc);
  const items = viewed.filter(kindOk);
  renderDeck();
  if (!items.length){
    const msg = state.view === 'Done' ? 'Is shelf mein abhi koi dekh li hui cheez nahi.' : 'Kuch nahi mila. Spelling ya filter badal kar dekhein.';
    $('list').innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${msg}<button type="button" id="reset">Wapas</button></div>`;
    shownItems = [];
    return;
  }
  const one = oneShelf();
  const key = i => one ? i.source + '|' + i.section : i.category;
  const ordered = one ? items : LIB.categories.flatMap(c => items.filter(i => i.category === c.name));
  /* ek shelf: us ke hisse STEP 01, 02… ke saath; andar wale hisse (↳) ko number nahi milta */
  const secs = [...new Set(items.map(key))], steps = {};
  if (one){ let n = 0; secs.forEach(k => { steps[k] = secs.some(o => o !== k && k.startsWith(o + ' › ')) ? 0 : ++n; }); }
  const label = i => one ? i.section.split(' › ').pop().replace(/^\d+\)\s*/, '') : shortOf[i.category];
  shownItems = ordered; shownKey = key;
  const heads = secs.length > 1 || !!state.q;
  let html = '', last = null, n = 0;
  for (const i of ordered){
    const k = key(i), fk = foldKey(k);
    if (k !== last && heads){
      const sub = one && !steps[k];
      const name = !one ? esc(label(i)) : sub ? '↳ ' + esc(label(i)) : `<span class="st">${String(steps[k]).padStart(2, '0')}</span>${esc(label(i))}`;
      html += `<button type="button" class="sec${sub ? ' sub' : ''}" data-fold="${esc(fk)}" aria-expanded="${!folded.has(fk)}" title="Dabane se yeh hissa band ya khulta hai">` +
        `<span class="nm">${name}</span><span class="ln"></span><span class="ct" data-ct="${esc(k)}"></span><span class="chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>`;
    }
    last = k;
    if (heads && folded.has(fk)) continue;
    html += row(i, n++);
  }
  $('list').innerHTML = `<div class="cols${animate ? ' anim' : ''}">${html}</div>`;
  marks();
}
/* nishan, AGLA tag aur progress ko dobara list banaye baghair taza karta hai */
function marks(){
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#list .row')];
  rows.forEach(r => {
    const d = done.has(r.dataset.id);
    r.classList.toggle('done', d); r.classList.remove('next');
    r.querySelector('.tick').setAttribute('aria-pressed', d);
  });
  const cand = unseenFirst(shownItems);
  const next = cand && rows.find(r => r.dataset.id === cand.id);
  if (next && oneShelf() && state.kind === 'All'){
    next.classList.add('next');

}
function setDone(id, v){

}

function renderSources(){

}

const SHELF_KEY = 'techno-library-shelf-v1';
function go(cat){
  state.cat = cat; state.q = ''; state.kind = 'All'; state.view = 'All'; state.labKind = 'All'; state.labTested = false; $('q').value = '';

/* har click par link neeche patti mein aata hai aur copy ho jata hai, taake tab na khule to bhi link mil jaye */
async function copyText(t){
  try { if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t); return true; } } catch(e){}
  try { const el = $('bar-url'); el.focus(); el.select(); return document.execCommand('copy'); } catch(e){ return false; }
}
/* pehle naya tab kholne ki koshish; chat ke andar (sandbox) yeh band hota hai, tab link copy ho kar patti mein aata hai */
let blockedOnce = false;
/* SANDBOXED = chat ka file preview: wahan browser naya tab kholne hi nahi deta, page kuch nahi kar sakta.
   Is liye wahan TAB button chhupa dete hain aur saaf bata dete hain. Download kar ke browser mein kholne par sab khulta hai. */
const SANDBOXED = window.origin === 'null' && location.protocol !== 'file:';
if (SANDBOXED){
  $('bar-open').hidden = true;
  $('hint').innerHTML = 'Is preview mein naya tab nahi khulta: naam dabane se link <b>copy</b> hota hai. Seedha kholne ke liye <b>Library_Links.md</b> kholein.';
}
function openTab(url, title){
  let w = null;
  try { w = window.open(url, '_blank'); if (w) w.opener = null; } catch(e){ w = null; }
  if (w){ showBar(title, url, 'Naye tab mein khul gaya · ', 'Naye tab mein khul gaya · '); return; }
  const msg = blockedOnce ? 'Link copy ho gaya · '
    : SANDBOXED ? 'Chat ke preview mein naya tab nahi khul sakta. Link copy ho gaya, browser mein paste karein. Seedha kholne ke liye Library_Links.md kholein · '
    : 'Browser ne tab rok diya (popup block). Link copy ho gaya, naye tab mein paste karein · ';
  showBar(title, url, msg, 'Link yeh hai · ', !blockedOnce);

}
async function showBar(title, text, okMsg, failMsg, wide){
  $('bar').classList.toggle('wide', !!wide);   /* lamba paigham poori line mein, kata hua nahi */
  $('bar-url').value = text; $('bar-open').href = text;
  $('bar').classList.add('on');
  const ok = await copyText(text);
  $('bar-title').textContent = (ok ? (okMsg || 'Link copy ho gaya · ') : (failMsg || 'Link yeh hai · ')) + title;
}
function lucky(){
  const pool = LIB.items.filter(i => !done.has(i.id));
  const list = pool.length ? pool : LIB.items;
  const pick = list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)];
  [...folded].filter(k => k.startsWith(pick.category + '|')).forEach(k => folded.delete(k));
  go(pick.category);
  const r = document.querySelector(`#list .row[data-id="${pick.id}"]`);
  if (r){ r.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); r.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => r.classList.remove('flash'), 1900); }

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const a = e.target.closest('a[href]');
  if (a){
    if (a.id === 'bar-open'){ e.preventDefault(); openTab(a.href, $('bar-title').textContent.replace(/^[^·]*· /, '')); return; }
    e.preventDefault();
    openTab(a.href, a.dataset.title || a.textContent.trim());
    if (a.classList.contains('go')) setDone(a.closest('.row').dataset.id, true);
    if (a.dataset.mark) setDone(a.dataset.mark, true);
    return;
  }
  const tick = e.target.closest('.tick');
  if (tick){ const id = tick.closest('.row').dataset.id; setDone(id, !done.has(id)); return; }
  const fold = e.target.closest('[data-fold]');
  if (fold){ const k = fold.dataset.fold; if (folded.has(k)) folded.delete(k); else folded.add(k); renderList(false); return; }
  if (e.target.id === 'top'){ window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}); return; }
  const tile = e.target.closest('[data-cat]');
  if (tile){ go(tile.dataset.cat); return; }
  if (e.target.id === 'v-close' || e.target.id === 'viewer'){ closeViewer(); return; }
  if (e.target.id === 'v-copy'){ copyLong(viewerText).then(ok => { $('v-copy').textContent = ok ? 'COPY HO GAYA' : 'COPY NAHI HUA'; }); return; }
  const fr = e.target.closest('[data-file]');
  if (fr){
    const [pid, grp, k] = fr.dataset.file.split('|');
    const p = PROJECTS.find(x => x.id === pid), f = p && (p[grp] || [])[+k];
    if (!f) return;
    if (f.code != null) openViewer(p, f);
    else if (f.url) openTab(f.url, pid + ' · ' + f.name);
    else showBar(pid + ' · ' + f.path, f.path, 'Path copy ho gaya. Chat mein likhein: “yeh file dikhao” · ', 'File ka path yeh hai · ');
    return;
  }
  const jp = e.target.closest('[data-jump]');
  if (jp){ const c = document.querySelector(`.pcard[data-pid="${jp.dataset.jump}"]`); if (c){ c.scrollIntoView({block:'start', behavior:'smooth'}); c.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => c.classList.remove('flash'), 1700); } return; }
  const cm = e.target.closest('[data-cmd]');
  if (cm){ showBar('command', cm.dataset.cmd, 'Command copy ho gaya · ', 'Command yeh hai · '); return; }
  const lk = e.target.closest('[data-labkind]');
  if (lk){ state.labKind = lk.dataset.labkind; renderList(true); return; }
  if (e.target.closest('[data-labtested]')){ state.labTested = !state.labTested; renderList(true); return; }
  const chip = e.target.closest('[data-kind]');
  if (chip){ state.kind = chip.dataset.kind; renderList(true); return; }
  const view = e.target.closest('[data-view]');
  if (view){ state.view = view.dataset.view; renderList(true); return; }
  if (e.target.closest('#lucky')){ lucky(); return; }
  if (e.target.id === 'reset'){ go(state.cat); $('q').focus(); return; }
  if (e.target.id === 'save'){
    const ids = LIB.items.map(i => i.id).filter(id => done.has(id));
    showBar('', 'Library done: ' + (ids.join(', ') || 'kuch nahi'), 'Copy ho gaya. Yeh line chat mein paste karein, progress pakki save ho jayegi.', 'Yeh line copy kar ke chat mein paste karein.');
  }
});
$('q').addEventListener('input', e => {

});
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => { $('top').hidden = window.scrollY < 500; }, {passive:true});
$('q').addEventListener('keydown', e => {

$('bar-close').addEventListener('click', () => $('bar').classList.remove('on'));
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {

try { const last = store && store.getItem(SHELF_KEY); if (last === 'All' || catBy[last] || (last === LAB && AGENTS.length) || (last === PROJ && PROJECTS.length)) state.cat = last; } catch(e){}

"""Rebuild Library_Dashboard.html (+ mirror index.html) and Library_Links.md from library.json. Run after every change."""
import json, os
BASE=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
lib=json.load(open(f"{BASE}/library.json"))
ids=[i["id"] for i in lib["items"]]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)), "duplicate shelf numbers"
cats={c["name"] for c in lib["categories"]}
bad=[i["id"] for i in lib["items"] if i["category"] not in cats]
assert not bad, f"items with unknown category: {bad}"
assert all(c.get("short") for c in lib["categories"]), "every category needs a short tab label"
unknown=[x for x in lib.get("done",[]) if x not in ids]
assert not unknown, f"done list has unknown shelf numbers: {unknown}"
# Agents Lab: every agent has a unique id, a known kind and chat status, and points at real shelf numbers.
agents=lib.get("agents",[])
aids=[a["id"] for a in agents]
assert len(aids)==len(set(aids)), "duplicate agent numbers"
for a in agents:
    assert a["kind"] in ("agent","pack","skill","mcp","flow","tool","list"), a["id"]
    assert a["chat"] in ("yes","half","no"), a["id"]
    assert all(f in ids for f in a.get("from",[])), f"{a['id']} points at an unknown shelf number"
    assert not (a["tested"] and not a.get("result")), f"{a['id']} is marked tested but has no result text"
# Projects: software and other work built in this chat, plus older projects found in the Ai School Drive folder.
# Each file entry is either local ({"path": relative to /home/user}) or remote ({"name","url"}).
# For local files the build adds size and line count, and the file text when "embed" is true, so the code can be read inside the dashboard.
import copy
ROOT=os.path.dirname(BASE)
projects=lib.get("projects",[])
pids=[p["id"] for p in projects]
assert len(pids)==len(set(pids)), "duplicate project numbers"
STATUSES=("done","live","building","code","copy","notbuilt")
fills={"items":len(lib["items"]),"shelves":len(lib["categories"]),"sources":len(lib["sources"]),
       "agents":len(agents),"tested":sum(1 for a in agents if a["tested"]),"projects":len(projects)}
def fill(x):
    if isinstance(x,str):
        for k,v in fills.items(): x=x.replace("{"+k+"}",str(v))
        return x
    if isinstance(x,list): return [fill(i) for i in x]
    if isinstance(x,dict): return {k:fill(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    return x
out_lib=copy.deepcopy(lib); embedded=0; missing=[]
out_lib["projects"]=fill(out_lib.get("projects",[]))
for p in out_lib["projects"]:
    assert p["status"] in STATUSES and p["group"] in ("chat","old"), p["id"]
    for grp in ("sources","data","outputs"):
        for f in p.get(grp,[]):
            if "path" not in f:
                assert f.get("url","").startswith("https://"), f"{p['id']}: file needs a path or a link"
                continue
            full=os.path.join(ROOT,f["path"])
            if not os.path.isfile(full):
                f["missing"]=True; missing.append(f["path"]); continue
            f["bytes"]=os.path.getsize(full)
            if f["path"].rsplit(".",1)[-1].lower() in ("js","mjs","py","html","css","md","json","txt","tsv","sh","yml","csv"):
                try:
                    text=open(full,encoding="utf-8").read()
                    f["lines"]=text.count("\n")+(0 if text.endswith("\n") or not text else 1)
                    if f.get("embed") and len(text)<=90000: f["code"]=text; embedded+=len(text)
                except UnicodeDecodeError: pass
            f.pop("embed",None)
if missing: print("WARNING, project files not found:",missing)
# "<" is written as \u003c so that no file text can close or confuse the <script> block it is embedded in.
data=json.dumps(out_lib,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")).replace("<","\\u003c").replace("\u2028","\\u2028").replace("\u2029","\\u2029")
html=open(f"{BASE}/tools/template.html",encoding="utf-8").read().replace("/*__DATA__*/",data)
for out in (f"{BASE}/Library_Dashboard.html", os.path.join(os.path.dirname(BASE),"index.html")):  # index.html is a mirror copy
    open(out,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(html)
print("built",len(lib["items"]),"items,",len(lib["sources"]),"sources,",len(agents),"agents,",len(projects),"projects,",round(embedded/1024),"KB of code inside,",round(len(html)/1024),"KB")

# ── Library_Links.md: same shelves and order as plain clickable links.
# The chat's HTML preview cannot open new tabs; links in a Markdown file (and in chat replies) are normal links.
import re
def md(s): return re.sub(r'([\\\[\]_*`<>|])', r'\\\1', s)
def size(b): return "" if not b else f"{b/1e9:.1f}GB" if b>=1e9 else f"{round(b/1e6)}MB" if b>=1e6 else f"{max(1,round(b/1e3))}KB"
L=["# Library — seedhe links","",
   "Kisi bhi naam par click karein, link khul jayega. Tarteeb wohi hai jo dashboard mein hai.","",
   f"{len(lib['items'])} items · {len(lib['categories'])} shelves · update: {lib['updated']}",""]
for n,c in enumerate(lib["categories"],1):
    items=[i for i in lib["items"] if i["category"]==c["name"]]
    if not items: continue
    L+=[f"## {n}. {c['short']} — {md(c['name'])} ({len(items)})",""]
    keys=list(dict.fromkeys((i["source"],i["section"]) for i in items)); step=0; last=None
    for i in items:
        k=(i["source"],i["section"])
        if k!=last and len(keys)>1:
            sub=any(o!=k and o[0]==k[0] and k[1].startswith(o[1]+" › ") for o in keys)
            name=re.sub(r"^\d+\)\s*","",i["section"].split(" › ")[-1])
            if sub: L+=["",f"**↳ {md(name)}**",""]
            else:
                step+=1; L+=["",f"### {step:02d} · {md(name)}",""]
        last=k
        f0=i["files"][0]
        extra="".join(f" · [+{md(f['kind'])}]({f['url']})" for f in i["files"][1:])
        info=f0["kind"]+(f" {size(f0.get('size'))}" if f0["kind"]=="Video" and f0.get("size") else "")
        L.append(f"- `{i['id']}` [{md(i['title'])}]({f0['url']}) · {info}{extra}")
    L.append("")
if agents:
    ran=sum(1 for a in agents if a["tested"])
    L+=[f"## Agents Lab ({len(agents)} agents, {ran} chala kar dekhe)","",md(lib.get("lab",{}).get("about","")),"",
        "Chat ka computer: "+md(lib.get("lab",{}).get("env","")),""]
    KN={"agent":"Agent","pack":"Agents pack","skill":"Skill","mcp":"MCP","flow":"Make automation","tool":"Tool","list":"List"}
    for key,label in (("yes","Isi chat mein check ho sakte hain"),("half","Adha: aap ka account ya key chahiye"),("no","Is chat mein nahi chal sakte")):
        its=sorted([a for a in agents if a["chat"]==key], key=lambda a:(not a["tested"],list(KN).index(a["kind"])))
        if not its: continue
        L+=[f"### {label} ({len(its)})",""]
        for a in its:
            flag=" · **chala kar dekha**" if a["tested"] else ""
            guess=" · repo pakka nahi" if a.get("sure") is False else ""
            L.append(f"- `{a['id']}` [{md(a['name'])}]({a['url']}) · {KN[a['kind']]}{flag}{guess} · {', '.join(a.get('from',[]))}  \n  {md(a['what'])} {md(a.get('result') or a.get('why',''))}")
        L.append("")
if projects:
    ST={"done":"mukammal","live":"chal raha hai","building":"ban raha hai","code":"code maujood","copy":"doosre ka project","notbuilt":"nahi bana"}
    L+=[f"## Projects ({len(projects)})",""]
    for key,label in (("chat","Is chat mein bane"),("old","Pehle ke projects (Ai School Drive folder)")):
        ps=[p for p in out_lib["projects"] if p["group"]==key]
        if not ps: continue
        L+=[f"### {label} ({len(ps)})",""]
        for p in ps:
            L+=[f"**`{p['id']}` {md(p['name'])}** · {ST[p['status']]}"+(f" · {md(p['version'])}" if p.get("version") else ""),"",md(p["what"])+" "+md(p.get("stage","")),""]
            for title,k in (("Ban chuka","done"),("Baqi hai","todo")):
                if p.get(k): L+=[f"- {title}: "+"; ".join(md(x) for x in p[k])]
            for title,k in (("Source files","sources"),("Data","data"),("Tayyar files","outputs")):
                fs=p.get(k,[])
                if fs: L+=[f"- {title}: "+", ".join(f"[{md(f['name'])}]({f['url']})" if f.get("url") else f"`{f['path']}`" for f in fs)]
            L.append("")
L+=["## Folders aur notes",""]
for s_ in lib["sources"]:
    head=f"[{md(s_['title'])} — poora folder]({s_['url']})" if s_.get("url") else md(s_['title'])
    L.append(f"- {head} · {md(s_['by'])} · {s_['items']} items"+(f"  \n  Note: {md(s_['note'])}" if s_.get("note") else ""))
open(f"{BASE}/Library_Links.md","w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(L)+"\n")
print("links file:",sum(1 for x in L if x.startswith("- `L-")),"items,",sum(1 for x in L if x.startswith("- `A-")),"agents,",sum(1 for x in L if x.startswith("**`P-")),"projects")

# Library — how this works (notes for the assistant)

- `Library_Dashboard.html` is the deliverable. When the user asks for the "library dashboard", open it with present_file. Do not ask them to download it.
- `library.json` is the single source of truth: categories, sources (each shared link) and items (one row per lesson/book/resource, with stable shelf numbers `L-001`…).
- After any change to `library.json`, run `python3 tools/build_dashboard.py`. It also writes a mirror copy to `/home/user/index.html`.
- Design the user chose: black background with neon glow, one shelf (tab) at a time, items in columns so a shelf fits on one screen with little scrolling. Keep it that simple.

## Adding a new link
1. Public Google Drive folder: `pip install gdown`, then `python3 tools/crawl_drive.py FOLDER_ID data/crawl_NAME.json` to list its files. Other links (single file, website, YouTube, book page): fetch the page and record title, author and what it is.
2. Check what it actually is before categorising. Note anything the user should know in the source `note` (re-uploaded paid course, unverified content, login needed).
3. Skip uploader promo files (ads for WhatsApp/Telegram channels, `.DS_Store`) and count them in `promo_hidden`.
4. Append a source (`S3`, `S4`…) and items continuing the shelf numbers; never renumber existing items. Group files that share a title (video + PDF + image) into one item.
5. Use an existing category when one fits; add a new one to `categories` only when none does (each category needs a `short` tab label, one word in capitals).
6. Set `updated` to today's date (Asia/Karachi), rebuild, then open the dashboard.

`tools/import_first_two.py` shows how the first two folders were imported (one-time script; do not rerun, it would reset the shelf numbers).

Drive folders added later (2026-11-23): `S4` Instagram Blueprint OS (`data/crawl_instagram_os.json`), `S5` Google AdSense training (`data/crawl_adsense.json`), `S6` Remote Job Accelerator mini course (`data/crawl_remotejob.json`). They were imported with an inline script using the same rules: promo files hidden and counted, video + saved page with the same title grouped into one item, uploader junk (`| ahm7tech…`) stripped from names, sizes read with a 1-byte range request to `drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=…&confirm=t` and stored in `data/sizes.json`. A single Drive folder with a re-uploaded course is still filed with an honest source note (what was sampled, what was not); only sites whose main business is cracked apps are left out.

## Dashboard features (version 4, "improve it yourself" round)
- Look the user chose: black background, neon cyan/green glow. Keep it simple and keep scrolling low.
- Shelves are icon tiles. Each category in `library.json` may have an `icon`: courses, agents, prompts, economy, invest, content, accounts, book, code, folder (default when missing).
- Sequence: inside a shelf the sections show as steps 01, 02, 03; a number at the start of a title ("3. ..." or "Lesson 3 - ...") is shown as the badge. Items stay in `library.json` order, so add new items in the order they should be followed.
- Progress: clicking an item (or its round tick) marks it "dekh liya". In a normal browser this is remembered (localStorage). In the chat preview it is NOT remembered, so a PROGRESS SAVE button gives the user a line like `Library done: L-001, L-043`.
  When the user pastes that line (or says an item is done), set the top-level `done` list in `library.json` to those shelf numbers and rebuild. The build fails on unknown numbers.
- Also: type filter chips (SAB / VIDEO / PDF / IMAGE / OTHER), LUCKY button (random unseen item), keys 1-9 switch shelf, `/` focuses search.

## Dashboard features (version 5, maximum usability upgrade)
- **UP NEXT deck:** the slim green strip always gives the next useful learning item and `KHOLEN` opens/copies it and marks it done. Obvious cover/preview images do not become the first learning step; for example, COURSES starts at the welcome video (`L-002`). If a shelf is complete, the deck directs the user to the next unfinished shelf.
- (Replaced in version 6 by the single SIRF BAQI toggle, see below.)
- A zero-result search has an explicit message in the UP NEXT strip instead of falsely saying a shelf is finished.

## Dashboard features (version 6, polish round: fewer controls, more guidance)
- **One filter row only:** `SAB` + type chips (VIDEO / PDF / IMAGE / OTHER). The old AAGAY / SAB / ✓ group was removed because two "SAB" buttons were confusing. A single `SIRF BAQI n` toggle appears only after something is marked done and something is still left.
- **Foldable steps:** every step heading (01 START, 02 LESSONS…) and every shelf heading in ALL is a button that folds/unfolds its rows and shows its own count (`2/10`, or `✓ 10` when finished). Everything is open by default; nothing folds on its own.
- **Search highlight:** matched words (and shelf numbers) glow in the results.
- **NEW marker (for future links):** when `library.json` holds items with more than one `added` date, the items of the latest date get a `NEW` tag, their shelf tile gets a cyan dot, and a `NAYA n` chip appears. So when adding a new link, give its items today's `added` date and the user sees at once what was added. With a single date (today's state) nothing is marked.
- **Finished shelf:** the tile turns green and shows ✓ instead of the count.
- **UP NEXT order:** the library-wide "next" follows shelf order (COURSES first), not shelf-number order.
- **↑ button** appears after scrolling down; the last open shelf is remembered in a normal browser (not in the chat preview).
- Foot text now says the link is copied and to paste it in the browser if no tab opens (the chat preview blocks new tabs).
- **Link opening (version 6.1):** every click first tries `window.open` (new tab). In a normal browser the bar says "Naye tab mein khul gaya"; a `TAB ↗` button in the bar re-opens it. Inside the chat preview (iframe sandbox without `allow-popups`) the browser returns null, so the bar explains once that tabs are blocked there and the link is copied instead. This is a platform limit of the preview, not fixable from the page.

## Opening links in a new tab — what works and what does not (settled, do not retry)
- The user wants: click → the link opens in a new browser tab. Inside the chat's HTML file preview this is IMPOSSIBLE: the preview frame is `sandbox="allow-scripts"` without `allow-popups`, so `window.open` and `target="_blank"` are both blocked. No page code can change that.
- Tried and failed, do not repeat: (1) a `TAB ↗` button / `window.open` in the page; (2) serving the dashboard with a local web server as a "live preview" — the user reported tabs still did not open, the sandbox is brand new on every message so the server dies, and the raw e2b address needs an access token. `tools/serve.py` was deleted.
- What the dashboard does now: in the chat preview it hides the TAB button, says plainly that tabs cannot open there, and copies the link. Opened as a downloaded file in a real browser, every click opens a new tab and ticks are remembered (browser-tested).
- **`Library_Links.md`** (built by `tools/build_dashboard.py` together with the HTML): the same shelves, steps and order as plain Markdown links. Markdown is rendered by the app itself, not in the locked frame, so its links should open normally — NOT yet confirmed by the user.
- Links written in a chat reply are ordinary links. When the user asks for an item by number or name, answer with the clickable link in chat.
- "Open the library dashboard" still means `present_file` on `Library_Dashboard.html`. If the user wants to click straight through, present `Library_Links.md`.

## Reels aur video links (source S3, added with the MOVIES and TOOLS shelves)
- The user sends bare Facebook / Instagram / YouTube links in chat and expects them to be filed here. All of them go under the single source `S3` ("Reels aur videos"); do NOT make a new source per reel. `S3` has no `url` (the template and the links file skip the folder link when `url` is empty). Keep `S3.items` equal to the number of its items.
- One reel = one item: `files: [{kind: "Video", url: <the link exactly as the user sent it>}]`, no `size`, no `section_url`. Put the creator in brackets in the title and say in a few words what it is.
- Shelves: movie lists, reviews and movie sites → `Movies & Series` (MOVIES; the user asked for this shelf). AI tools, websites, GitHub projects → `AI Tools & Websites` (TOOLS). Agents/bots → AGENTS, clipping/collab/earning from content → CONTENT, prompts → PROMPTS, tutorials → COURSES.
- Not filed on purpose: "message me, I will teach you trading" reels (scam pattern), conspiracy series, time-limited news, links that could not be opened, sites that hand out cracked ("premium unlocked") apps or pirated paid courses, and "free trial" tricks that need a fake location. Tell the user which ones were left out.
- To read a reel: `yt-dlp` on the link (web.facebook.com → www.facebook.com), 16 kHz WAV via the `imageio_ffmpeg` binary, `faster-whisper` small with a numpy array in 14 s chunks (`task='translate'` for Hindi/Urdu), plus a contact sheet of frames for on-screen text.
- Facebook posts (`story.php?story_fbid=X&id=Y` or `/posts/`): `story.php` redirects to login. Rewrite to `https://www.facebook.com/Y/posts/X/` and fetch with `curl -A "facebookexternalhit/1.1"`; the `og:title` (page), `og:description` (first ~200 characters only) and `og:image` (the post picture, downloadable with the same user agent) are all that can be read. Say so to the user. Save the rewritten `/Y/posts/X/` link (it is the clean form of what the user sent).
- When adding to a section that already exists, INSERT the item after the last item of that category + section (do not append at the end), so the section heading is not repeated. Shelf numbers still continue from the highest one.

## Reading the full text of posts and reels (found in the back-check, November 2026)

- Facebook post, full text and comments: `curl -sL -A "Googlebot/2.1 (+http://www.google.com/bot.html)" <post URL>`, then take every `"text":"..."` JSON string of 60+ characters (regex `"text":"((?:[^"\\]|\\.){60,})"`, decode with `json.loads`). The post text comes first (long posts are split into several strings), then the comments. This replaces the older note that only about 200 characters can be read.
- Facebook reel, caption: the same command on `https://www.facebook.com/reel/<ID>`. The first string is the caption of that reel; the strings after it are captions of other reels by the same creator, so do not mix them up. Comments are not included.
- Instagram image post (`/p/<ID>/`): the same user agent returns `og:image` and `"display_url"` values. Download the largest one into a folder under `/home/user`, then view it in a later step. Text on the page may belong to the author's other posts.
- Full prompt texts that were read this way are kept in `notes/Prompts_pure_text.md`. Add new ones there under the item id.
- Other checked lists live in `notes/` too: `notes/Harvard_free_courses.md` (official Harvard free AI and coding courses with certificate prices, for `L-135`).

## Standing rule from the user

Everything the user sends must be checked properly before it is filed: open it, read the full text or transcript, open the tool or repo it points to, and check claims (price, dates, requirements) against the source. Say plainly what could not be checked.


## Agents Lab (dashboard ka pehla tile)

`library.json` → `agents` = every agent, agents pack, skill, MCP server, Make.com automation and agent tool found in the links so far. `lab` = intro text and the chat computer's limits. Top-level `open` decides where the dashboard opens: `"projects"`, `"lab"`, or leave it out for the first shelf.

One agent = one entry:

```json
{"id":"A-57","name":"…","kind":"agent|pack|skill|mcp|flow|tool|list","what":"1 line, Roman Urdu","url":"repo ya source link",
 "from":["L-111"],"chat":"yes|half|no","tested":false,"why":"kyun chal sakta hai ya nahi","result":"","sure":true}
```

- `chat`: `yes` = can be run inside this chat with no account; `half` = needs the user's account, login or API key; `no` = cannot run here (Docker, GPU, phone, 8 GB RAM, Make.com).
- `tested: true` only after it was really run here, and `result` must then say what happened. A file that was only read is not "tested".
- `sure: false` when the repo was found by name and the source did not give the exact link.
- When a new link names an agent or skill: add the library item as usual **and** an `agents` entry. New numbers continue from the highest `A-` number; never renumber.

How things were run here (20 s each, no login):

```bash
export npm_config_prefix=/tmp/ag/npm PATH=/tmp/ag/npm/bin:$PATH; npm i -g opencode-ai
# a skill: copy its folder (the one holding SKILL.md) into <project>/.opencode/skills/, then
opencode run -m opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free "Use the skill tool to load the skill named '<name>'. <task>" </dev/null
```

- Clone repos into `/home/user/.cache/aglab` (on disk). `/tmp` is only 1 GB and lives in RAM; filling it kills other programs.
- Run one OpenCode at a time: two at once get killed for memory (exit 137).
- Always add `</dev/null` inside a `while read` loop, or OpenCode eats the rest of the list.
- agency-agents: `scripts/convert.sh --tool opencode`, then `scripts/install.sh --tool opencode --division marketing` from the project folder. ECC: `install.sh --profile full --target opencode --no-hooks`. Playwright MCP needs `--browser chromium --no-sandbox`.

## Projects (dashboard ka doosra tile)

`library.json` → `projects` = the software and other work built in this chat (`group: "chat"`) and the older projects found in the user's Ai School Drive folder (`group: "old"`).

```json
{"id":"P-13","group":"chat|old","name":"…","kind":"app|tool|report|bot|copy","status":"live|done|building|code|copy|notbuilt",
 "version":"…","licence":"…","what":"1-2 lines","stage":"where it stands now","tech":["…"],
 "done":["…"],"todo":["…"],"tests":["what was checked and what was not"],
 "run":[{"cmd":"…","about":"…"}],
 "sources":[{"path":"aik-3d-studio/src/app.js","about":"…","embed":true}],
 "data":[…],"outputs":[…],"next":"…"}
```

- A file is local (`path`, relative to `/home/user`) or remote (`name` + `url`, for Drive or GitHub).
- The build adds size and line count to every local file. With `"embed": true` it also puts the file text into the dashboard, so the user can read the code there ("CODE DEKHEIN"). Limit 90,000 characters per file.
- Never set `embed` on `Library_Dashboard.html`, `index.html` or `library.json`: the dashboard would contain a copy of itself and grow on every build.
- Texts may use `{items}`, `{shelves}`, `{sources}`, `{agents}`, `{tested}`, `{projects}`; the build fills in the current numbers.
- `status: "code"` means the code exists but nobody checked that it runs. Write in `tests` what was really checked.
- When work starts or continues on a project, update its `stage`, `done`, `todo` and `tests` in the same turn. New numbers continue from the highest `P-` number.
- Agents Lab test files (script, questions, raw answers) are kept in `data/lab/`.

"""One-time import of the first two Drive folders into library.json."""
import json, re, os, datetime, zoneinfo
BASE=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
PROMO=re.compile(r"Join Us|Click To Join|Earning Websites|Opening not recommended|for telegram users|Bouns Free|Join free Vip|More Courses|\.DS_Store|500K Free Resources",re.I)
sizes=json.load(open(f"{BASE}/data/sizes.json"))
today=datetime.datetime.now(zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Asia/Karachi")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

KIND={".mp4":"Video",".pdf":"PDF",".png":"Image",".json":"Template",".txt":"Text",".html":"Web page",".docx":"Doc",".prfpset":"Preset"}
def split_name(name):
    m=re.search(r"__(pdf|png|mp4)$",name)
    if m: return name[:m.start()], "."+m.group(1), True
    stem,ext=os.path.splitext(name)
    if stem.lower().endswith(".png"): stem=stem[:-4]
    return stem, ext.lower(), False
def clean(t,q):
    t=re.sub(r"\bAl\b","AI",t)
    t=re.sub(r"^(\d+)__",r"\1. ",t)
    t=re.sub(r"^(\d+)\s*[.)]\s*",r"\1. ",t)
    t=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",t).strip(" ,_")
    t=re.sub(r"\s*·\s*AIGrid Academy.*$","",t)
    t=re.sub(r"\s*-\s*The Future AI Economy$","",t)
    t=re.sub(r"\s*-\s*TheAIGRID \(720p, h264\)","",t)

## L-098: kisi bhi topic ke 5 viral hooks

Post: https://www.instagram.com/p/DfkMuA_Sg8d/

Tasveer se haath se utara gaya hai (November 2026). `[FILL IN]` ki jagah platform aur topic likhna hai.

```
<prompt>
<role> You are a 2026 Viral Post Strategist who specializes in authentic, scroll stopping content that feels human, not AI generated. Your expertise is creating hooks that combine psychological triggers with genuine emotion and specific, verifiable detail. </role>

<my_inputs> Platform: [FILL IN]. Topic or content: [FILL IN]. </my_inputs>

<analyze_2026_patterns> Authenticity beats perfection. Audiences are saturated with AI generated content, so visible human fingerprints (specific details, imperfect delivery, real opinions) build trust. The first 1 to 2 seconds decide everything, but retention decides reach. A hook must earn the watch AND set up a payoff worth staying for. Pattern interrupts outperform clickbait. Audiences punish hooks the content does not deliver on. Emotion plus specifics equals shares. Sends and saves matter more than likes. Community driven beats promotional. Invite replies, stitches and debate. Searchability matters. Platforms increasingly work as search engines, so work natural keywords into the hook or on screen text. </analyze_2026_patterns>

<platform_rules> TIKTOK, IG REELS, YOUTUBE SHORTS: Land the hook in the first 3 words, with a matching visual in the first frame. Use bold on screen text that works with the sound off. Promise a transformation or revelation, then deliver it fast. Raw, in the moment footage beats polished production. Design for rewatches and sends (loops, "wait for the end", dense payoffs). FACEBOOK: Video and original, community made content get priority. Hooks that spark discussion outperform broadcast style posts. Emotional storytelling with a clear, natural CTA. "Tag someone who" drives shares, but only when it fits the content. TWITTER OR X: Strong opinions or hot takes you can defend. Thread style value with a first line that stands alone. Data plus personal story combo. Write to spark thoughtful replies, not just outrage. LINKEDIN: Vulnerability plus professional insight. "Here is what nobody tells you" angle (only with a real, specific insight behind it). Career transformation stories with concrete numbers or timelines. Strong first two lines, since they show before the "see more" cutoff. </platform_rules>

<task> Create 5 viral hooks. </task>

<power_patterns> Numbers that shock: "I analyzed 1,000". Time specificity: "In 47 seconds". Negative angles: "Stop doing X immediately". Pattern break: "Everyone is wrong about". Social proof: "This got 50K shares because". Micro story openings. Curiosity gaps (but always deliver value). </power_patterns>

<psychology_2026> FOMO plus genuine urgency. Contrary positioning. Relatable struggle, then solution. "You vs. Them" dynamics. Surprising data reveals. Human vs AI authenticity: "I tested this myself" or "no script, no AI". </psychology_2026>

<avoid> Generic "How to" starts. Overused emojis without context. Vague promises. AI sounding language (for example: "game changer", "unlock", "dive into", "in today's fast paced world", heavy use of dashes). Fake urgency, fabricated statistics or invented personal stories. Use placeholders like [your real number] where specifics are needed. Clickbait the content cannot pay off. </avoid>

<viral_hooks> Write hook1, hook2, hook3, hook4 and hook5. For each one give the hook and why it works psychologically. </viral_hooks>

<strategy_breakdown> Explain: which hook will likely perform best and why. What emotional trigger each uses. How to test these hooks effectively (A/B test the first line, compare retention and sends, not just views). Platform specific optimization tips. </strategy_breakdown>

<content_angles> Provide 3 alternative content angles for this topic that have not been overdone in your niche. </content_angles>

<remember> Viral content in 2026 feels like a smart friend sharing gold, not a marketer selling something. Write hooks people want to screenshot and share. </remember>
</prompt>
```
