# Ai School folder: deep check

Checked on 13 November 2026 (Asia/Karachi). Nothing in your Drive was changed; everything here was read-only.

## Verdict

The folder holds real, useful work, but it does not do the job it was built for. It is meant to let a new AI pick up where the last one stopped, and right now a new AI that follows the start file gets the thinnest version of your history, a book labelled "ready" that is not, and no mention of your newest work. It also exposes private client pricing notes to anyone who has the link.

## What I checked

| Step | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Listed | Every folder and file: 11,463 files in 1,357 folders |
| Downloaded and scanned | 2,012 files: everything outside the God's Eye View source and dependency folders, except 44 large media files |
| Opened in detail | The root brain files, both book manuscripts, both covers, the paperback PDFs, the book database, the three HTML dashboards, the Slack bot code, the bookmark data and the client project notes |
| Checked live today | Your YouTube channel page, your Blogger feed and the Slack bot address |

## Findings, most important first

### 1. Private client material is readable by anyone with the link

I opened the folder and downloaded files without signing in, so anyone holding the link can do the same.

- [`Private_Pricing_and_Shoot_Notes.md`](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Rpf-OaAQk5-QSoNcR19J1QrX1PVh_Cg3/view) contains your opening price (PKR 25,000), negotiation target (PKR 22,000) and floor (PKR 20,000) for the Mohsin Raza job. The note itself says not to show it to the client.
- The same [`client_projects`](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aM_lG6WFk4ywmsimuRfjqRTCm1HtGqxu) folder has the quotation, the WhatsApp draft and 263 working files.
- [`Ahsan Raza`](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ProlFU0qvXkwnZIKCJ5ZtgPs4Ngpgf2T) holds 11 product videos for COSLUS and PRITECH.

I found no live passwords, API keys or tokens in the 2,012 files or in the 147 files inside the small ZIPs. The key-shaped strings that turned up are Google's own public keys inside saved YouTube and Drive pages, plus a placeholder Slack address in a README.

### 2. The "master" files are the shortest copies

The start file tells a new AI to read the root files. Fuller versions sit in the [`Ai School Brain 29-Sep-26`](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fiXEJyEDEGPaa0uDFz4ZSBR1upPA7dqL) folder, and the two sets have drifted apart.

| File | Root copy (23 Oct) | Copy in the 29-Sep folder |
|---|---|---|
| `02-MASTER-MEMORY.md` | 258 words | 1,553 words |
| `03-MASTER-LINKS.md` | 128 links | 512 links, 433 of them missing from the root copy |
| `05-CURRENT-STATE.md` | Updates from 14 to 23 Oct only | Updates from 30 Sep to 8 Oct only |

Neither `05-CURRENT-STATE.md` is complete: the root copy lacks 15 sections (the Facebook Reel batches, Like4Like, Techythem and others) and the older copy lacks the 23 sections added after 14 October. Across the whole folder there are 22 copies of `00-START-HERE.md` in 3 different versions, and 23 copies of `05-CURRENT-STATE.md` in 6 versions.

### 3. "The Free AI Toolkit" is not ready to upload

The handoff calls it "100% ready". The files say otherwise.

| What the notes claim | What the file shows |
|---|---|
| "23 Zero-Dollar AI Tools" (master memory) | 10 tools, and a different subtitle on the manuscript and cover |
| Complete 7-chapter book | 2,203 words in total, including the title and copyright pages |
| Table of contents | Plain text: 0 links, 0 bookmarks, no heading styles, so Kindle navigation will not work |
| Formatted manuscript | Raw symbols are printed in the text, such as `**Duck.ai** \| ` and backticks around `.psd`; the bookmark "table" is a bullet list with pipe characters |
| "8K, 300 DPI" cover | 768 × 1,376 pixels at 72 DPI, against KDP's recommended 1,600 × 2,560; it also has a 3D book spine drawn in, where an eBook cover should be flat |
| Evidence database | Intact (10 revisions), but 0 research records, policy status "unverified", country "United States" |

The book also promises "no hardware demands" and tools that are "100% free" without stating their limits, which readers will test.

### 4. Your second book is in better shape and the brain does not mention it

[`The 30-Day Downsize`](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ffvVO47cmynV2tIuUfY_ZA72GrE3UnFq), made on 25 October, has what the first book lacks:

- 14,407 words with proper heading styles (48 chapter-level, 201 section-level).
- A 1,600 × 2,560 cover at 300 DPI.
- A 141-page 6 × 9 inch paperback PDF and a wrap cover of 12.567 × 9.25 inches, which matches KDP's size for 141 pages on white paper. On cream paper the spine would be wider and the cover would need redoing.
- An upload guide that answers the AI-content question with "yes".

I checked its structure and dimensions, not the accuracy or originality of its text. No handoff or current-state file refers to it.

### 5. The brain stopped on 23 October

- The newest handoff is dated 23 October. The second book (25 Oct), the earlier review (25 Oct) and the Ahsan Raza videos (28 Oct) are not recorded anywhere a new AI is told to look.
- A previous AI already wrote a deep review, saved at [`WorkSpace/ai_school_review/Ai_School_Deep_Review.md`](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11ZjrupAhQGN2MRQF_p26f8eL5ICGADii/view). I reached the same conclusions on the book, cover, database and God's Eye console independently. None of its fixes have been applied: the root files were last modified on 23 October.
- The original Ai School task, a progress-tracker dashboard and a linked PDF for the 12-course curriculum, has been marked "next" since 18 September and was never built.

### 6. Two thirds of the folder is downloaded dependency code

- 7,456 of the 11,463 files (65%) are in [`vendor_modules`](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vMMYGM-4n98Fz5gVIwTcHINZuPYRMklN), a copy of third-party packages for God's Eye View. The 18 October note says this was removed and the workspace cut to 219 files; the Drive copy still has it.
- Of the 2,012 files I downloaded, 1,043 (52%) are exact duplicates of another file.
- The earlier review added to this by saving its own 171-file copy of the folder inside the folder.
- `Lerning How to Learn` and `Hugingface` are still misspelt, an item open since September.

### 7. Smaller points

- **Audience versus target.** The plan needs 87 book sales a month. Today the channel has 14 subscribers and 19 videos, the same count as the 15 October note, and the blog's 88 posts were last updated on 24 March 2025.
- **God's Eye console.** [`gods_eye_interactive_console.html`](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oOAoLVx42MpmjiYzQhPMCao0MWlcvXV7/view) makes no network calls. "LIVE RADAR ACTIVE · 11,420 CONTACTS" is fixed text, so it is a visual demo and not a tracker.
- **Slack bot.** The address still answers. The code only verifies that a message came from Slack if the signing secret is set, so without it anyone can trigger the bot.
- **Bookmarks.** The archive of 188 bookmarks includes a Photoshop crack and torrent page (procrackfile.com). Keep it out of anything you publish.

## What is in good shape

- The research method in `04-SKILLS-AND-DEAD-ENDS.md` is sound: official page first, separate claim from test, say "unverified" when it is.
- The hardware rule (4 GB RAM, browser and cloud tools only) is applied consistently.
- The daily digest and Slack bot are real working code, not mock-ups.
- The book database is internally consistent.

## What I did not check

- The 9,400 files of God's Eye View source and dependencies, beyond listing them. This is third-party code.
- The contents of 44 large videos, audio files and animations, and the 12.9 MB master ZIP.
- Anything behind a login: your KDP account, YouTube Studio, AdSense, or whether the daily digest still runs.
- The tool verdicts in your notes (Freebuff, Saluki 27B, REA, Odysseus and others). I did not re-test them.

## Suggested order

1. Move `client_projects` and `Ahsan Raza` out of the shared folder, or turn off link sharing for them.
2. Merge the two sets of brain files into one current set at the root, and move every other copy into a single archive folder.
3. Add one handoff covering 25 October onwards: the second book, the client jobs and this review.
4. Decide which book goes first. The Downsize book is closer; the AI Toolkit needs a rewrite, proper headings and a new cover before upload.
5. Delete `vendor_modules` from Drive. It can be re-downloaded from the original project at any time.

The full file list, with a Drive link for every file, is in `Ai_School_Full_Inventory.csv`.
